scope: NAI Blue UI performance, all registered agent generation visibility, saved output directory navigation
findings: Scene authority projected and serialized every preset for unrelated store updates.
Generation persistence serialized thumbnail history again on transient progress updates.
Broad subscriptions rerendered shell/editor/history; Library always measured draggable items.
File agent workspace reread all Scene documents after unrelated state changes.
Scene Queue dropped preview frames; shell activity exposed only guided drafts and counts.
Configured generation folders omitted existing Artifact and legacy Scene output directories.
Startup reread the whole Scene collection for each already-linked artifact and reapplied repeated preset documents.
implemented: Changed-preset authoring checks; persisted-field identity deduplication; focused UI subscriptions; idle drag measurements removed; lazy async image decoding.

All Queue jobs expose an ephemeral per-job live projection; Main and Scene forward Provider frames. Latest frame at 200ms intervals, at most four active cards/four recent results. Overlay preserves editor route.

One metadata catalog initialization per app session, 128-record pages and eight concurrent path resolutions; synchronous save events update it. Windows path normalization and legacy paths included. Folder section shows 40 at a time; gallery 60 at a time.
Existing Scene links reuse bulk snapshot; missing links retain fresh reads and CAS. Each highest preset revision is projected once.
